newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - IVORY COAST - DEC 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IVORY COAST - DEC 16.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- About 20,000 new jobs to be created yearly in 1997 and 1998 under Ivorian government's job creation programme, says employment minister Atsain Achi.
- Regional meeting of aviation ministers agrees on liberalisation of air transport in West Africa from May 1, 1997.
- Private firm Publicom soon to provide cellular public telephone booths in Ivory Coast
- Regions to receive total of 10 billion CFA for housing programmes.
